snippet.title: Roll 'Em Out Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Your friend has been cursed! He transformed into a ball. You must Roll 'em Out of the cave to keep it from collapsing! Its just how curses work.

A brand new game by Shortgun Games. Best experienced with 4 players.

#IndieGame #Gaming #CoopGame #RollEmOut
